summary: Example task backs up the EOS config with eos_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up an Arista switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up EOS config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (eos)
  arista.eos.eos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_eos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'
```
